items.s: Users reported withdrawal delays and freeze notices as wallets attributed to BitMart fell to about $69 million and its BMX token extended an 81.5% weekly decline.

items.h: Garden Finance disables app as Blockaid reports $450,000 exploit
items.s: Garden Finance said no user funds or smart contracts were affected after an attacker compromised an independent solver’s off-chain database and inserted fraudulent swap records.

items.h: STORJ token falls 20% as decentralized storage firm files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy amid crypto shutdown wave
items.s: STORJ dropped 19% to $0.06 after Storj Labs filed voluntary Chapter 11 on July 26 to resolve legacy liabilities.
alt: Storj files for bankruptcy, explores equity path for tokenholders

items.h: CLARITY hopes fade, BitMEX shuts as lawsuit looms: Hodler’s Digest, July 26
items.s: Despite support from Goldman Sachs, Fidelity and law enforcement bodies, the Clarity Act’s chances dim. BitMEX to close as crypto consolidates into five big players.

items.h: WEMIX says attacker moved about $724,000 after contract breach
items.s: WEMIX suspended bridges, liquidity-pool trading and several services after an attacker compromised a WEMIX$-linked contract and moved 724,198 USDC.e.

items.h: Why Hashdex’s new crypto ETF keeps 100% of your initial staking yields and 40% of everything else
items.s: Provider fees come first; above the annual threshold, excess net staking income is split 40% to Hashdex and 60% to the trust.

items.h: The brutal $346M math behind Galaxy’s high-stakes race to build CoreWeave’s Texas AI mega-center
items.s: Phase II handovers are expected to begin in 2027 as the project company takes on fixed cash costs.

items.h: CFTC issues second warning to prediction markets on cookie-cutter self-certifications
items.s: For the second time this year, the regulator told prediction markets to stop issuing overly broad, template-style certifications of events contracts.

items.h: Russia’s Sberbank to launch crypto trading infrastructure this year
items.s: Russia’s biggest bank plans to create cryptocurrency trading infrastructure by Dec. 1 as the country is set to establish rules for market participants while allowing crypto assets to be used in foreign trade operations.

items.h: Mira Murati’s Inkling AI Model Review: Best Open-Weights Model in the West
items.s: After two years of silence from Thinking Machines Lab, Murati's debut model is out and on OpenRouter. The MCP score is genuinely impressive. The price-to-performance math is more complicated.

items.h: Bitcoin OG selling eases as dormant BTC movement hits 4-year low: Galaxy
items.s: Dormant BTC activity fell to its lowest level since Q3 2022, suggesting long-term holders have slowed distribution after heavy profit-taking.
